title: A solo owner session gets its own merge role, and only it may use it
why: The merge role file has no form for a solo session that the owner started (follow-up of step merge-role-allow).
note: Pick taken by the coordinator, no page item (16:32 CST Nov 7): option C. The session-start hook writes merge role 'solo-owner' into the role file only when the session has no parent and no cs-build tag. read_merge_role accepts it only when the session id in the file equals the calling session's own id. Coordinator pick, 18:18 CST Nov 7, can be undone (round 3, lane session_013NEJL1PAG3NhmQAbveNQLo): a solo owner session's merge confirm runs with no ask only in repos whose standing-merge-grant record grants solo merges (claude-settings today). Elsewhere the ask stays, and an untagged coordinator is refused. No page item.
